subject: MAP kickoff: NovaMed MAP Draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novamed.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@novamed.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: MAP kickoff: NovaMed MAP Draft & timeline options

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and helpful context on your use case for LLM-powered clinical note summarization. As promised, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that captures the milestones we talked about, proposed owners from both sides, and two timeline options (8-week and 12-week).

Quick summary of the MAP (see attached PDF for details):
- Milestone 1: Technical kickoff & environment access — Owner: NovaMed (IT) / Redwood (Eng) — Target window: week 1
- Milestone 2: Integration & data ingestion proof-of-concept — Owner: Redwood Eng (Dev) / NovaMed Data Ops — Target window: weeks 2-4
- Milestone 3: Performance tuning & evals (latency, accuracy) — Owner: Redwood Applied ML / NovaMed Clinical SMEs — Target window: weeks 5-6 or 7-10
- Milestone 4: Security/compliance sign-off (SOC2 artifacts review + data handling agreement) — Owner: NovaMed Security / Redwood Security — Dependency: SOC2 evidence + legal review
- Milestone 5: Contract SOW + procurement — Owner: NovaMed Procurement / Redwood Sales — Target close date: choose 2026-04-30 (8-week) or 2026-05-28 (12-week)

Ask: please confirm the following so we can finalize the MAP and schedule the kickoff meeting:
1) Primary stakeholders we should include on the MAP (IT lead, Data Ops, Clinical SME, Legal/Procurement contact) — names & emails
2) Preferred timeline (8-week vs 12-week) and target close date
3) Any non-standard compliance or procurement requirements we should surface now (e.g., in-country hosting, additional attestations)

I've attached: NovaMed_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft) and NovaMed_SOW_Template_v1.docx (SOW template for procurement). If it helps, we can hold a 30-min MAP kickoff this week — my availability: Thu 3/5 2-4pm PT or Fri 3/6 9-11am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and covers what we discussed. A few quick notes from my side: 

- We prefer the 12-week timeline to give our clinical SMEs enough runway for evaluations and approvals. Target close date of 2026-05-28 works.
- Please add our IT lead (Tom Hsu) and Procurement contact (Sarah Lin) as owners on the MAP; I'll add Clinical SME names by end of day Monday.
- For compliance: we need to confirm that Redwood can support in-region hosting for PHI processing — our security team will flag this if not supported. Also request to see SOC2 Type II evidence and data retention policies (we discussed during call).

Can we tentatively schedule the kickoff for Monday 3/9 at 10:00am PT? Tom and I can do that slot.

Emily

- Access: NovaMed will provide a test dataset dump + temporary S3 access OR VPN access to a sandbox environment. Which option is preferred for a POC?
- Integration approach: API-based streaming vs bulk batch ingestion — we recommended API streaming on the call to keep latency low, but confirm any gotchas.
- Compliance items: Redwood to provide SOC2 Type II report + data retention policy; security can provide a short checklist of artifacts.

Dev (SE) — can you own Milestone 2 (integration/PoC) and Milestone 3 (tuning/evals)? Aditya — can you own Milestone 1 (kickoff & env setup) and coordinate with Dev on the integration plan? I'll own Milestone 5 (SOW/procurement coordination).

Tom / Emily — tentative kickoff Monday 3/9 10:00am PT ok? If yes, I'll send calendar invite with a short agenda (introductions, environment/access, success criteria, next 2 weeks).
